item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 9
item.description:
GitHub Copilot weekly releases for November 9 add support for GitHub Enterprise Server repositories in the Copilot app and a way to identify which agent sessions need attention first in VS Code. The release also includes access to two new models, with the post text truncating after “Claude.”

  • Source: GitHub
